instruction: Convert all text in my document to uppercase for emphasis.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully converted all uppercase text to lowercase using Ctrl+A to select all, then Format > Text > lowercase, then Ctrl+S to save. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all text (Ctrl+A), navigate LibreOffice Writer menus (Format > Text > case options), save documents (Ctrl+S). Comfortable with text case conversion operations.
metadata.task_rationale: Reverse operation of the original task - converting to uppercase instead of lowercase. Same interaction pattern (select all, format menu, case change) but different target case.
metadata.explanation: Task requires converting all document text to uppercase. Getter extracts all paragraph and table text, metric checks that >= 95% of alphabetic characters are uppercase.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all text from both paragraphs and tables in the docx file, providing complete text coverage for verification.
Metric correctly counts uppercase vs total alphabetic characters with reasonable thresholds (95% for full score, 80% for partial).
Postconfig properly activates the Writer window and saves the document (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.
Single instruction requirement (convert all text to uppercase) is fully covered by the evaluator.

Minor issue: Metric function ignores the 'expected' parameter entirely (which contains {'case': 'upper'}), hardcoding the uppercase check instead. This works correctly for this specific task but means the expected rules config is unused.
